data_gap.reason: Theme accuracy, insight acceptance, and finding support stay unavailable until real reviewers save adjudicated decisions. A quote that is present in a transcript is not a support judgment. A claims-audit match is a reproducibility check, not human validation. This file does not contain invented labels, and an LLM was not used as a judge.

leakage.note: Reviewer corrections are read only when metrics are scored. They are not written back into the keyword taxonomy or the TF-IDF/NMF fit. The lexical model was fit on every transcript, including those later drawn for review. It is a diagnostic. The governed category is the keyword assignment, and the review sample is stratified on that predicted category plus call type, not on a gold label.

sampling.method: Representative sample: reserve one meeting for every predicted governed theme that occurs, then allocate the remaining seats by the largest-remainder method on (count - 1). Within a predicted theme, seats are split across support, external, and internal by the same method. These strata are the model's primary theme and the ingestion call type. They are not gold labels. Meetings inside a stratum are drawn with random.Random seeded by 7, the theme, and the call type. Inclusion probability is stratum seats divided by stratum size. Corrected labels are not fed back into the topic model. Challenging cases are every meeting already on the review queue. That list is not a probability sample and is scored on its own.
sampling.challenging_bias: These meetings were queued because the theme margin was thin or the held-out topic shared no words with the supplied labels. Accuracy here is not the accuracy of a random meeting. Do not average it with the representative sample.
sampling.pooling: Representative and challenging results are reported separately. A meeting can sit in both lists and still has one human decision. The two denominators are not added together.

representative.headline: NOT YET AVAILABLE
representative.warning: No adjudicated human labels yet. Accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 are not calculated.

accuracy_interval.caveat: No adjudicated labels, so no interval is calculated.

representative.note: Eligible rows are confirmed predictions, or corrections that name one of the eight themes, plus older accept and edit rows that name a theme, after any conflict has been adjudicated. Ambiguous, insufficient evidence, pending, and unadjudicated conflicts stay out of precision, recall, F1, and accuracy. They remain in the review-coverage counts. The confusion matrix counts labeled rows. It is not weighted. Strata were drawn on the predicted theme, not on a gold label. Population estimates weight each representative row by the inverse of its selection probability. The accuracy interval is a Wilson 95% interval on the labeled rows and is not a design-based variance. Macro averages skip themes with no labeled support, and skip an undefined precision rather than treating it as zero. Reviewer corrections are not used to refit the topic model.

accuracy_interval.caveat: No adjudicated labels, so no interval is calculated.

Ambiguous, insufficient evidence, pending, and unadjudicated conflicts stay out of precision, recall, F1, and accuracy. They remain in the review-coverage counts. The confusion matrix counts labeled rows. It is not weighted. Strata were drawn on the predicted theme, not on a gold label. Population estimates weight each representative row by the inverse of its selection probability. The accuracy interval is a Wilson 95% interval on the labeled rows and is not a design-based variance. Macro averages skip themes with no labeled support, and skip an undefined precision rather than treating it as zero. Reviewer corrections are not used to refit the topic model.

topic_classification.pooling_note: Representative and challenging results are reported separately. A meeting can sit in both lists and still has one human decision. The two denominators are not added together.

business_insights.note: Acceptance rate is accepted / (accepted + rejected). Needs revision and needs more evidence are reviewed, and they are not in that denominator. If nothing has been accepted or rejected, the rate is N/A rather than 0% or 100%. Approval coverage is accepted / all insights, and is N/A when nothing has been reviewed. No insight is accepted by default.

findings_verification.note: quotes_found means the cited string occurs in the meeting's transcript, summary, or source key moment after whitespace and ellipsis are folded. It does not mean a person agreed the passage supports the claim. passages_to_check are nearby sentences with a contrast word. They are a reading aid, not contradictions. human_support_status stays pending until a reviewer saves supported, partially supported, unsupported, or insufficient evidence.

findings.title: What keeps coming back to support
findings.claim: Reliability and incidents is the primary theme on 13 of 27 support calls. Identity and access is next with 5. The raw labels underneath are fragmented (incident communication (5), feature request (4), workaround (4)). The theme is the rollup a support leader can staff against. The raw label is the evidence.
findings.recommended_action: Staff the weekly support review by theme, starting with Reliability and incidents. Bring the engineering owner for that theme, not a rotating on-call who has to re-derive the pattern.
findings.known_limitations: Share of support calls whose primary governed theme is reliability. The theme is a keyword map.

findings.known_limitations: Module cohorts are keyword assignments on the meeting text. A meeting can mention more than one product.

findings.title: Accounts where the transcript is already a renewal problem
findings.claim: 24 accounts have at least one call with explicit churn language. The score weights repeated churn signals, a low mean, a named competitor, and a renewal already on the calendar. It is a briefing rank, not a forecast.
findings.recommended_action: Work the top of this list as one book: one owner, the quote, the competitor, and a date for the technical assurance the customer asked for. Do not leave it distributed across whoever last hosted the call.
findings.known_limitations: Accounts are grouped by account name, or by the only external domain when the name is blank. The rank is not a churn probability.

findings.title: Which competitors the transcripts actually name

findings.recommended_action: Update the SentinelShield talk track with the failure the customers are citing, not a generic feature grid. Re-count this list after the next month of calls before declaring the competitive set stable.
findings.known_limitations: Counts use a configured competitor list. A name that is not on the list is not counted.

claims_audit.note: check_status is whether this run recomputes the published number. review_status stays not_human_verified. A match is not acceptance of the business conclusion. Account identity uses account_name, and falls back to the only external domain when the name is blank. Meetings that share a domain but carry different account names are listed as ambiguous matches and are not silently merged.

claims.aggregation_method: Count of meeting folders that loaded. One folder is one meeting. Duplicate meeting ids are listed separately and are not dropped.
Count of theme definitions in the governed taxonomy. This is the list length, not the number of meetings that received a theme.
Arithmetic mean of summary.json sentimentScore for meetings whose call type is support. Compared at two decimal places, which is how the briefing prints the mean.
Arithmetic mean of summary.json sentimentScore for meetings whose call type is external. Compared at two decimal places.
Meetings whose title, summary, or supplied topics contain 'outage' or 'pipeline failure'. This is the sentiment analyzer's outage cohort, which is wider than incident-titled meetings.

Distinct account keys among meetings that have an external domain and at least one source key moment of type churn_signal. The key is account_name, or the only fallback customer_domains[0] when account_name is blank. Several meetings for one account count once. This is the same rollup the sales-at-risk finding publishes. It is not a forecast.

implemented: Topic review can confirm, correct, mark ambiguous, or mark insufficient evidence.
Insight review can accept, reject, request revision, or request more evidence.
Conflicting reviews stay unresolved until an explicit adjudication.
Quote location and the headline counts can be checked from source files.
insufficient_evidence: No human has marked a transcript or a finding as insufficient evidence.
readiness.note: Validated stays empty until adjudicated human decisions exist. Automated checks do not fill it.
